info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Status API provides insights into the current status of various education enrollments within the system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive information about enrollment statuses, which can be beneficial for educational institutions, administrators, and students alike. Typical consumers of this API include application developers, school management systems, and reporting tools looking to track enrollment metrics. By leveraging this API, users can effectively manage and analyze enrollment data for strategic planning and operational improvements.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of enrollments for the given context. Use this to check if enrollments are open, closed, or in progress.

requestBody.description: Request body for obtaining the current enrollment status. This request should include necessary parameters to filter or identify the enrollment status being queried.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, providing the current enrollment status.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusRequest.description: A string representation for the enrollment status in the context of the GET request operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.title: Enrollment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the enrollment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the enrollment request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result related to the enrollment.

state.description: The current state of the enrollment process.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, taken to process the enrollment request.

message.description: A message providing more details about the enrollment operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response for enrollment status retrieval operations.
